chunks: And from him, from Abū Jaʿfar, from al-Ḥasan ibn ʿAlī ibn Yaqṭīn, from his brother al-Ḥusayn ibn ʿAlī ibn Yaqṭīn, from his father, from Abī al-Ḥasan al-Awwal عليه السلام, who said:
I asked him about a man who performs سجود: how much tasbih suffices him in his rukūʿ and his sujūd? He said: Three, and one suffices him.

key_terms.التَّسْبِيحِ: the prescribed glorification of Allah in this act of worship
key_terms.يُجْزِيهِ: is sufficient for him; fulfills the minimum requirement

ai.seo_question: What is the minimum amount of tasbih that suffices in rukūʿ and sujūd?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling regarding the minimum amount of tasbih in rukūʿ and sujūd. It indicates that saying the tasbih three times is the standard, while one utterance is still sufficient to fulfill the minimum requirement.
